title: VethuQ signed policy envelope (v1)
description: What /v1/policy.json contains. The payload is carried as base64url of the exact bytes that were signed, so no JSON re-serialisation is ever needed to verify.

kid.description: Id of the key that produced sig. Must equal payload.kid.

payload.description: base64url (RFC 4648 section 5, no padding) of the exact UTF-8 payload bytes that were signed. Decodes to a JSON document valid against policy.schema.json.

sig.description: base64url (no padding) of the 64-byte Ed25519 signature over the decoded payload bytes.
